characters.name: Pyramid Head
characters.appearance: Pyramid Head from the ORIGINAL Silent Hill 2 (2001): a tall heavily built adult male monster, bare pale muscular upper arms and torso partly covered by a dirty off-white long butcher apron, heavy dark boots, enormous RUSTED DARK RED ANGULAR PYRAMID METAL HELMET completely hiding head and face. The helmet has the ORIGINAL sharp wedge geometry, not the later movie design. RIGHT hand holds the real enormous broad flat GREAT KNIFE, dragging or making one heavy physical swing. No exposed face, no teeth, no extra monster, no film chains, no magic. Keep apron weathered but NO blood, gore, wounds or victim.

characters.name: James Sunderland
characters.super: Frappe au tuyau d’acier de James
characters.appearance: James Sunderland from the ORIGINAL Silent Hill 2 (2001), not remake. Adult white man with short sandy blond hair, olive-green military field jacket with small patches, grey shirt, dark blue jeans, dark brown shoes. His actual rusty straight STEEL PIPE is held in his RIGHT hand. Never a crowbar, sword, rifle or magic.

characters.name: Heather Mason
characters.super: Tir ajusté au pistolet de Heather
characters.appearance: Heather Mason from ORIGINAL Silent Hill 3 (2003). Seventeen-year-old protagonist, short uneven blonde bob with darker roots, white sleeveless hooded vest over orange high-neck shirt, short olive GREEN skirt, tall BROWN boots, orange wristband. Fully clothed original adventure costume, natural proportions, no glamorization. Actual ordinary black handgun held safely in BOTH HANDS when aiming, holstered or pointed low otherwise. Never magical pregnancy power, beam, sword, alien costume or remake design.

characters.name: Harry Mason
characters.appearance: Harry Mason from ORIGINAL Silent Hill (1999). Adult white man with short swept brown hair, brown casual leather jacket over a dark green shirt, blue denim jeans, dark shoes. An ordinary black HANDGUN is his only selected weapon, held in BOTH HANDS while aiming, low or holstered otherwise. No crowbar, steel pipe, tactical armor, magic or remake costume.

characters.name: Alessa Gillespie
characters.work: Silent Hill (1999), apparition d’Alessa en uniforme scolaire
characters.appearance: Alessa Gillespie, the fully clothed school-uniform apparition from ORIGINAL Silent Hill (1999), not movie. Quiet fourteen-year-old schoolgirl with straight dark brown shoulder-length hair, navy blue sailor school uniform, white sailor collar, small RED neckerchief, knee-length pleated dark skirt, white socks and plain black shoes. Respectful neutral nonsexual depiction. Empty hands. No bandages, exposed skin beyond ordinary hands/face, injuries, blood, weapon, fire, floating cross, magical barrier or damaging power. Support is a quiet grounding gesture only, never offensive magic.

characters.name: Maria
characters.work: Silent Hill 2 (2001), Maria du jeu original
characters.super: Indication du passage sûr par Maria
characters.appearance: Maria from ORIGINAL Silent Hill 2 (2001), not remake. Adult woman with a short BLONDE bob with PINK lower tips, PINK long-sleeved short jacket/cardigan with the original butterfly detail, LEOPARD-PRINT short skirt, black knee-high boots, original restrained pixel-art game silhouette. Fully clothed original costume, neutral posture, no pinup framing. EMPTY HANDS, no cleaver, knife, sword or supernatural attack. Her selected role points out a safe route and stays calm; directions are not damaging powers.

characters.name: Cybil Bennett
characters.work: Silent Hill (1999), agente de police de Brahms
characters.appearance: Cybil Bennett from ORIGINAL Silent Hill (1999): adult blonde woman with short blonde hair, BLUE short-sleeved police shirt with shoulder patches, black leather trousers, black police duty belt and tall black boots, ordinary black police HANDGUN held with both hands when aiming. NO film uniform, hat, fantasy rifle, infection or supernatural transformation.

characters.name: Claudia Wolf
characters.work: Silent Hill 3 (2003), Claudia humaine avant transformation
characters.appearance: Claudia Wolf in ORIGINAL Silent Hill 3 (2003), human version before any transformation. Adult pale woman, very long straight PALE BLONDE hair, nearly absent eyebrows, ankle-length plain BLACK high-neck long-sleeved dress, BARE FEET. Empty hands, subdued expression. Keep original normal human body. No staff, weapon, wings, demonic pregnancy, ritual wound, glowing hands, magical healing or offensive spell. Her selected team-support action is merely a restrained spoken instruction and a beckoning hand.

characters.name: Regina
characters.appearance: Regina from ORIGINAL Dino Crisis (1999). Adult athletic woman with short RED bob haircut, original dark charcoal/black sleeveless tactical top and fitted tactical trousers, red-accent black boots, long dark protective forearm gloves, black belt/holster, modest original game uniform. Actual ordinary black HANDGUN held with both hands while aiming. No cybernetic armor, blue energy knife, time beam, dinosaur minion or remake costume.

characters.name: Dylan Morton
characters.work: Dino Crisis 2 (2000), soldat T.R.A.T. de l’US Army
characters.super: Tir au fusil à pompe de Dylan
characters.appearance: Dylan Morton from ORIGINAL Dino Crisis 2 (2000). ADULT MAN, muscular but natural, short BLOND cropped hair, original GREEN sleeveless military TACTICAL VEST over a black undershirt, green camouflage combat trousers, black gloves, dark boots and utility belt. Clearly masculine original character. His actual physical pump-action SHOTGUN held with TWO HANDS is his selected weapon, lowered except when aiming. Not Regina, no red bob, no female bodysuit, no futuristic laser, time magic or grenade launcher.
